Controlled-access dataset | July 2026

A synchronized RGB-D strawberry dataset for greenhouse perception

The dataset contains 3,758 paired frames and 14,286 annotated strawberry instances. Each annotated strawberry includes a bounding box, five anatomical keypoints, a ripeness label, and an occlusion label.

Download dataset View dataset statistics
Modalities
RGB images, aligned depth maps, post-processed depth maps, and raw depth maps
Annotations
Bounding boxes, keypoints, ripeness labels, and occlusion labels in LabelMe JSON format
Research tasks
Object detection, keypoint estimation, ripeness recognition, and occlusion recognition
Capture system
Four Intel RealSense D435i cameras
Image resolution
1280 × 720 pixels
Dataset split
Train 3,006 frames, Validation 752 frames

03

Data specification

Modalities and annotation protocol

Every four-digit sample ID identifies one synchronized record inside either train or validation. Post-processed aligned depth is used for the 3D visualization below, with calibration selected from the dataset-wide image-to-camera mapping.

Data modality File format Count Purpose
RGB 1280 × 720 PNG 3,758 Appearance, localization, and attribute recognition
Aligned depth 16-bit depth PNG aligned to color 3,758 RGB-D fusion and metric geometry
Processed depth Spatial, temporal, and hole-filled aligned depth 3,758 Stable visualization and downstream geometry
Raw depth Original 16-bit depth PNG 3,758 Reprocessing and sensor-level studies
Instance label LabelMe JSON 3,758 Boxes, five keypoints, ripeness, and occlusion
Calibration map Per-image XLSX mapping plus four camera JSON files 3,758 Select the correct camera intrinsics for metric reconstruction

Annotation hierarchy

LabelMe JSON schema

3 levels
{ Root
version 5.5.0
flags object
shapes[] ordered annotation objects
Instance shape_type: rectangle
label points: 2 bbox corners group_id occlusion ripeness
Keypoints shape_type: point
label points: (x, y) group_id visibility
… repeat for each instance
imagePath · imageData image metadata
imageHeight · imageWidth integer
}
01

Structure

The JSON file stores image metadata and annotations. All labels are organized in shapes[] .

02

Instance

Each strawberry instance is represented by one bounding box. points defines the bounding box, while group_id links the instance with its attributes and keypoints.

label: strawberry points: 2 × [x, y] (top-left & bottom-right corners) group_id: instance id ripeness: 0 | 1 occlusion: 0 | 1
03

Keypoints

Each strawberry contains five anatomical keypoints: Cut, Top, Bottom, Left, and Right. group_id associates each point with its instance, and visibility records keypoint visibility.

label: Cut | Top | Bottom | Left | Right points: [x, y] (location) group_id: instance id visibility: 0 | 1 | 2
04

Baseline evaluation

Keypoint benchmark results

Eleven representative pose-estimation configurations were evaluated without external ground-truth boxes on the same 685-record validation set. Results are grouped by publication year, with configurations from each model family kept together.

Strawberry keypoint benchmark results ordered by publication year and model family
Model Year AP AP50 AP75 AR GFLOPs
CID-HRNet-W32 2022 74.84% 96.76% 86.33% 80.30% 43.17
CID-HRNet-W48 2022 74.44% 96.71% 84.95% 80.00% 85.38
YOLOX-Pose-S 2022 72.24% 96.60% 81.43% 78.04% 31.55
YOLOX-Pose-M 2022 74.33% 96.67% 83.75% 79.57% 84.53
YOLOX-Pose-L 2022 76.64% 96.68% 86.62% 81.47% 174.73
EDPose-R50 2023 77.37% 97.64% 88.52% 83.83% 276.51
EDPose-Swin-L 2023 78.49% 97.31% 88.67% 84.83% 422.60
EDPose-Swin-L-5scale 2023 77.21% 97.27% 87.28% 83.79% 681.92
RTMO-S 2024 71.73% 96.15% 80.86% 77.63% 42.60
RTMO-M 2024 71.07% 96.43% 80.26% 77.24% 69.00
RTMO-L 2024 74.76% 96.50% 84.55% 80.41% 136.70
Ours

Metric definition. AP is COCO keypoint AP averaged over OKS 0.50:0.95; AP, AP50, AP75, and AR are reported as percentages. GFLOPs denotes the estimated cost of one forward pass.

Compute note. EDPose GFLOPs are literature-reference or estimated values; the actual five-keypoint configuration may be slightly lower.
